metadata.note: Pre-flood graph uses all OSM roads; post-flood graph removes roads whose midpoint lies inside flood_mask.tif. The flood mask is unvalidated (damage-point recall against EMSR927 is near zero; see data/processed/emsr927_comparison.json), so the cut_off flags are provisional and should not be read as the real event.
